candidate_contract.signature: void dense_16x32_llm(data_t input[16], data_t weights[16][32], data_t bias[32], data_t output[32])
candidate_contract.operation: For each output o, compute output[o] = bias[o] + sum_i input[i] * weights[i][o].

testbench.input_rule: Use deterministic small fixed-point values for input, weights, and bias.
testbench.golden_rule: Compute the same dense formula in the testbench with a tolerance of 0.01.

demo.description: LLM candidate version of the Dense fallback demo; used to test whether generated HLS can replace local fallback templates under real Vivado verification.
